name: @sammons/typed-mind-cli
description: Command-line interface for TypedMind DSL - a declarative language for building software architectures
author: sammons

scripts.prepack: pnpm -w run lint && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.guard:npm-publish: node -e "if (!(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('publish with pnpm, not npm (workspace:* would ship verbatim)'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (!(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('publish with pnpm, not npm (workspace:* would ship verbatim)'); process.exit(1); }" && pnpm run clean && pnpm run build && pnpm -w run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.validate:package: pnpm exec publint && pnpm exec attw --pack .
scripts.release:dry: pnpm run build && pnpm run validate:package && pnpm publish --dry-run --no-git-checks
